author: Sarah M.
text: The best Ethiopian food in Dubai! The injera is perfectly spongy and the Doro Wot is absolutely incredible. Feels like home cooking.

author: Ahmed K.
text: Love Grass never disappoints. The Tibs are always cooked to perfection and the coffee ceremony is a beautiful experience. Highly recommend!

author: Priya R.
text: Finally found authentic Ethiopian cuisine in Dubai. The Beyeyanetu vegan platter is a must-try — so many flavors in one dish!

author: Daniel T.
text: Amazing atmosphere and even better food. The staff made us feel like family. The Kitfo was the best I've had outside of Addis Ababa.

author: Fatima A.
text: Great place for a group dinner. We ordered the mixed platter and it was perfect for sharing. The Shiro is comfort food at its finest.

author: Michael L.
text: I bring every visitor to Dubai here. The food is authentic, the portions are generous, and the prices are very fair. Love this place!
